cookie_banner.body: We use essential and analytics cookies to improve your experience. You can accept all or reject non-essential ones. See our cookie policy for details.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This page explains how 9bit uses cookies on this website.
cookies.section_what_body: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They help the website remember information about your visit.
cookies.section_use_body: We use essential cookies to make the site function (language preference, consent state) and optional analytics cookies to understand how visitors use the site. We do not sell or share data with third parties for advertising.
cookies.section_essential: Essential — required for the site to work (consent state, locale).
cookies.section_analytics: Analytics — anonymous usage data, only after you accept.
cookies.section_manage_body: You can clear cookies in your browser settings at any time. Rejecting non-essential cookies will limit analytics but will not affect site functionality.
cookies.section_contact_body: Questions about this policy? Email hola@9-bit.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: 9bit respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.section_data_body: When you fill the contact form we collect: name, email, optional phone, and your message. We do not track personal data beyond what you submit.
privacy.section_use_body: We use your contact information solely to reply to your inquiry. We do not share, sell, or transfer it to third parties.
privacy.section_storage_body: Submissions are stored only as long as needed to respond and follow up. You can request deletion at any time.
privacy.section_rights_body: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by emailing hola@9-bit.com. Under GDPR you have the right to object, restrict processing, and lodge a complaint with the AEPD (Spanish data protection authority).
